from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # marker color = the one forming long straight segments; sample color = rest
    cells={}
    for c in others:
        cells[c]=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==c]
    marker=max(others,key=lambda c:len(cells[c]))
    sample_col=[c for c in others if c!=marker][0]
    samples=cells[sample_col]
    # split marker cells into two collinear segments
    mc=cells[marker]
    vertical= len({j for i,j in mc})>=1 and (len({i for i,j in mc})>len({j for i,j in mc}))
    # group by line
    segs={}
    for i,j in mc:
        segs.setdefault(i if not vertical else j,[]).append((i,j))
    assert len(segs)==2, segs
    lines=sorted(segs)  # for vertical: column coords; for horizontal: row coords
    # span along the segment direction
    def span(pts):
        xs=[p[0] if vertical else p[1] for p in pts]
        return min(xs),max(xs)
    (l1,pts1),(l2,pts2)=sorted(segs.items())
    s1,e1=span(pts1); s2,e2=span(pts2)
    # near segment: the one whose span contains a sample's along-coord
    def along(p): return p[0] if vertical else p[1]   # coord along segment
    def perp(p): return p[1] if vertical else p[0]    # coord perpendicular
    near_l = l1 if any(s1<=along(p)<=e1 for p in samples) else l2
    far_l = l2 if near_l==l1 else l1
    near_pts = segs[near_l]; far_pts = segs[far_l]
    ns,ne=span(near_pts); fs,fe=span(far_pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for p in samples:
        out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
        # ray toward near segment (perpendicular direction)
        step=1 if near_l>perp(p) else -1
        q=perp(p)+step
        while q!=near_l:
            if vertical: out[p[0]][q]=sample_col
            else: out[q][p[1]]=sample_col
            q+=step
    # far segment rays at pattern-copied positions
    for p in samples:
        rel=along(p)-ns
        t=fs+rel
        if not (fs<=t<=fe): continue
        # span from far segment to opposite grid edge
        if vertical:
            j=far_l
            if j==0: rng=range(1,w)
            elif j==w-1: rng=range(0,w-1)
            else: rng=range(0,w)  # ambiguous
            for jj in rng: out[t][jj]=sample_col
        else:
            i=far_l
            if i==0: rng=range(1,h)
            elif i==h-1: rng=range(0,h-1)
            else: rng=range(0,h)
            for ii in rng: out[ii][t]=sample_col
    return out
